name: Axosoft
description_en:
Axosoft is a Scrum and bug-tracking application for software teams. It organizes backlog items into projects, releases and workflows, with release-capacity planning and recorded work supporting delivery discussions. A practical evaluation starts with the relationship between estimated work, available people and the intended release date.

Its official site offers both hosted and installed options, so the old catalog’s generic cloud label was incomplete. The documentation also exposes important configuration details: field templates determine what people see, workflow actions can change data, and WIP limits may warn or prevent movement depending on settings. This profile reports documentation behavior, not an installation or compatibility test.
description_zh:
Axosoft 是面向软件团队的 Scrum 与缺陷跟踪应用。它把待办事项组织到项目、发布版本和工作流中，并用发布容量规划和已记录工作支撑交付讨论。实际评估应从工作估算、可用人员和目标发布日期之间的关系开始。

官网提供托管和自行安装两种方式，因此旧目录笼统的云服务标签并不完整。文档还揭示了重要配置细节：字段模板决定用户看到什么，工作流动作可能修改数据，WIP 限制则根据设置发出警告或阻止移动。本文报告文档行为，没有实际安装或进行兼容性测试。

sections.title_en: Plan work against capacity, not a date alone
sections.title_zh: 按容量规划，而非只设日期
sections.en:
For a hypothetical maintenance release, choose its start and due dates, add participating users, then assign estimated bug fixes. The Release Planner shows both user and overall release capacity and marks over-allocation in red. Working days, daily capacity, holidays and vacation affect the available time; the display can use hours or another selected unit.

An illustrative person with five six-hour workdays has 30 available hours before other adjustments. Assigning 36 estimated hours would exceed that simple budget by six. This is arithmetic to prepare an evaluation, not a measured Axosoft result. Verify the selected unit and cross-release allocation before interpreting the indicator.
sections.zh:
假设准备发布一个维护版本，可以先选择开始和截止日期、加入参与人员，再分派已估算的缺陷修复。Release Planner 展示个人与整个版本的容量，超量时标红。工作日、每日容量、假期和休假都会影响可用时间，显示单位可以是小时或其他所选单位。

举例来说，一位人员若有五个每天六小时的工作日，在其他调整前有 30 小时可用时间。分派 36 小时估算工作，会比这份简单预算多六小时。这是用于准备评估的算术例子，并非 Axosoft 实测结果。解读提示前，还需核对所选单位和跨版本分派。

sections.title_en: A custom field may exist without appearing on the form
sections.title_zh: 字段存在，不等于表单已显示
sections.en:
Axosoft’s interface separates an organizing panel, an item workspace and item details. Selecting a project, release or user filters the workspace. List, card and rank views provide different ways to inspect the backlog.

Field templates determine the form used to create or edit an item. Newly created custom fields are placed in Hidden Fields for all templates and must be moved into Visible Fields where needed. If a pilot requires a customer-impact field, verify it on the relevant item template rather than concluding that creating the field made it visible everywhere.
sections.zh:
Axosoft 界面分为组织面板、事项工作区和详情。选择项目、发布版本或用户，会筛选工作区；列表、卡片和排名视图提供不同的待办检查方式。

字段模板决定创建或编辑事项使用的表单。新建自定义字段会进入各模板的 Hidden Fields，需要在所需模板里移到 Visible Fields。如果试点要求填写客户影响字段，应检查相关事项模板，不能认为创建字段后所有地方都会自动显示。

sections.title_zh: 流程切换可能清空信息
sections.en:
Step Actions set field values when an item enters a workflow step. For example, a completion step can set a completion date. The documentation warns that selecting a field without entering a value replaces its existing value with empty data. Step Actions also do not make fields mandatory; required-field behavior belongs to field templates.

Before applying a workflow broadly, move a disposable item through each transition and compare its data. If information disappears, inspect the checked fields and values in the step action configuration. The recommendation follows the documented risk; this research did not perform the transition.
sections.zh:
Step Actions 会在事项进入工作流步骤时设置字段值，例如在完成步骤写入完成日期。文档警告，勾选字段却不填写值，会把原值替换为空。Step Actions 也不会把字段变成必填项，必填行为由字段模板处理。

大范围采用工作流前，建议让一条可丢弃事项经过各个转换，并比对数据。如果信息消失，应检查步骤动作配置中的勾选字段和对应值。这项建议依据文档风险提出，本次没有实际执行转换。

sections.title_en: Warnings and enforced WIP limits differ
sections.title_zh: 警告与强制 WIP 限制不同
sections.en:
WIP limits can constrain the number of items in a workflow step or the items assigned to a user within that step. The option to restrict movement when the user WIP limit is reached makes the limit preventative instead of merely displaying a warning.

For a code-review stage, decide whether exceeding the limit should be allowed with a warning or prevented. Test with a representative reviewer and a second incoming item. A red capacity indication in release planning should not be assumed to impose the same restriction as this explicit workflow option.
sections.zh:
WIP 限制可以约束某个工作流步骤中的事项数，也可以约束该步骤内分派给某用户的事项数。启用“达到用户 WIP 上限时限制事项移入”选项后，系统才会预防超量，而不只是警告。

例如代码审阅阶段，需要先决定超过上限时允许继续并提示，还是直接阻止。建议使用一位代表性审阅者和第二条待进入事项验证。发布规划中容量标红，不应直接视为具有这里明确设置的流程阻止效果。

sections.title_en: Read velocity as a configured calculation
sections.title_zh: 把速度理解为可配置计算
sections.en:
Daily Scrum mode shows assigned work, remaining work, logged hours and velocity for participating users, plus a projected completion date. The documentation allows velocity to use either initial estimates or remaining estimates plus actual work and says user capacity is considered.

A projected date is therefore dependent on the data and selected calculation. Keep estimates, remaining work and logs meaningful before relying on the display for release conversations. This is a reporting interpretation, not evidence that the tool predicts delivery accurately or improves team performance.
sections.zh:
Daily Scrum 模式展示参与者已分派工作、剩余工作、记录工时、速度和预计完成日期。文档允许速度采用初始估算，或采用剩余估算加实际工作，并说明会考虑人员容量。

因此，预计日期依赖输入数据和选定计算方式。用它讨论发布前，应维护有意义的估算、剩余工作和工时记录。这是在解释报表，不能据此证明工具预测准确或提升团队表现。

sections.title_en: Hosted and installed have different responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 托管和自行安装承担不同责任
sections.en:
The public pricing calculator exposes hosted monthly/annual billing and an installed option but returned placeholder amounts, so a payable rate remains unknown. The page states an installed renewal of 35% of the license configuration cost and directs installed trials to sales. That percentage alone cannot establish a first-year budget.

The installed requirements list Windows Server, IIS, .NET Framework and SQL Server. Several listed versions are old; this page does not establish a maintained 2026 compatibility or security-support matrix. Ask the vendor for the supported stack and license terms before deployment. A self-installed commercial option is not evidence of open-source licensing.
sections.zh:
公开定价计算器提供托管月付／年付和自行安装选项，但金额返回占位符，因此实际费率仍未知。页面说明，自行安装许可证续费为配置成本的 35%，安装版试用需联系销售。仅有这个比例，不能得出首年预算。

安装要求列出 Windows Server、IIS、.NET Framework 和 SQL Server，其中若干版本较旧；该页面不能确立截至 2026 年仍受维护的兼容性或安全支持矩阵。部署前应向厂商确认受支持技术栈及许可条款。商业软件可以自行安装，不代表采用开源许可。

sections.title_en: Git integration is not the Git tool itself
sections.title_zh: Git 集成不等于 Git 工具本身
sections.en:
Axosoft’s GitHub integration document describes webhook and commit linkage and explicitly limits support to online GitHub, excluding GitHub Enterprise. The website’s separate Git Tools link points to GitKraken. Do not turn that navigation relationship into a claim that Axosoft contains a full Git client.

A software team seeking backlog, sprint and bug tracking can investigate Axosoft with one representative release. Validate current GitHub compatibility and authentication before relying on an older setup guide. Teams needing a different server stack or general business-work collaboration should first prove fit for those needs. No account, installation or repository connection was tested.
sections.zh:
Axosoft 的 GitHub 集成文档描述 webhook 和提交关联，并明确仅支持在线 GitHub，不支持 GitHub Enterprise。官网另有指向 GitKraken 的 Git Tools 链接，不能据此声称 Axosoft 内置完整 Git 客户端。

需要待办、迭代和缺陷跟踪的软件团队，可以用一个代表性版本进一步评估。依赖较旧配置指南前，应验证当前 GitHub 兼容性与身份验证。需要其他服务器技术栈或通用业务协作的团队，应先证明对应需求能够满足。本次没有测试账户、安装或仓库连接。
